title: Watchers: watch, watchEffect and cleaning up after them

videos.script:
Last lesson drew a line. A value that follows from other values is a computed. Doing something when a value changes is a watcher. {{watch}} This lesson is about the second half, the side effects. Saving, fetching, anything that reaches outside the component.

You start with watch, and the three kinds of thing it can watch. {{options}} Then three options, deep, immediate and once, and five watchers answering the same three clicks.

{{effect}} Then watchEffect, which finds its own sources, and loses the ones it reads after an await.

{{flush}} Then timing. Before the page is redrawn, after it, or at once.

{{race}} Then the bug that never shows on a fast machine. Two requests, answered in the wrong order, and the older answer wins. A cleanup fixes it.

{{stop}} Then a watcher that keeps running after its component is gone.

{{save}} And last, the planner keeps its sessions in your browser, saved by a watcher, so that nothing you change is lost on a reload.
